time_standard: ET/TDB seconds past J2000; UTC converted by NAIF LSK
interpolation: cubic Hermite; derivative is analytic derivative of interpolated R
utc_et_note: During this exported week UTC elapsed seconds equal ET elapsed seconds to <1ms; no leap second. Use epoch_et+t for TDB dynamics. SPICE UTC conversion was used for epoch.

validation.method: cubic Hermite elementwise R and dR/dt from sxform; measured at 1/4,1/2,3/4 of every interval
validation.precision_scope: Interpolation only; kernel/model/data uncertainties are separate. Interior samples are measured checks, not a rigorous error bound.
